display_title: I Can't Divorce Because I Love My Family

titles_en.title: I Can't Divorce Because I Love My Family
I Love My Family Too Much, That's Why I Can't Get Divorced
I Love My Family Too Much to Get a Divorce
My Daughter Is Cute and My Husband Is Cool
My Family Is Too Precious to Let Go

titles_native.title: 家族が愛おしくて離婚できません

titles_romaji.title: Kazoku ga Ai Oshikute Rikon Dekimasen

description:
I found myself lost in a novel world, possessing an utterly ordinary supporting character. I intended to live quietly, but swept along by events, I ended up marrying the heroine's father. My plan was simple: “Make the daughter happy, then divorce.” That was all it should have been.

But the daughter was adorable, and her husband clumsy yet kind. Smiles gradually filled the once-cold house, and her “divorce plans” began to waver alongside her growing desire to live in this home. Despite misunderstandings from others, family complications, and the original story's “separation route” standing in their way, the three of them slowly reclaim the warmth of family through small daily choices.

(Source: Piccoma, translated)
